decision.explanation: Both 'Annie Phillips' (from D1S2, D1S8, D1S27) and 'Robert French Handcock' (from D2S2, D2S4, D2S16) are explicitly identified as spouses of Isabella Louisa Gordon in the provided source segments. The documents present conflicting accounts regarding her marital history (one citing a same-sex marriage in 1895, the other a heterosexual marriage in 1855). Per the instruction to treat all sources as fallible and to preserve distinct valid referents without collapsing competing assertions, both names are retained as valid answers derived directly from the text.
